sanctuary.label: The Sanctuary Era
sanctuary.heading: 1983-1984: The Sanctuary Era
sanctuary.description: Following the 1981 Shap Fell disaster, Rhys and Claire retreated to a soundproofed ranch house in Williamsport, Maryland. Refusing to hire session musicians, the siblings physically played every instrument themselves, recording these sweeping progressive concepts in total isolation.

albums.title: Carnaby Street
albums.description: Written in the safety of a transatlantic sanctuary following a devastating loss. A sweeping progressive pop record where profound grief meets an eventual emotional breakthrough, physically played entirely by the surviving siblings.
